title: Flashcards: Capitals reversed, the Americas
intro: Flip each card about the Americas. Mark the ones you knew; the others come back sooner. Every answer shows its source.

cards.front: Saint John's is the capital of which country?
cards.explain: Saint John's is the capital of Antigua and Barbuda.

cards.front: Buenos Aires is the capital of which country?
cards.explain: Buenos Aires is the capital of Argentina.

cards.front: Belmopan is the capital of which country?
cards.explain: Belmopan is the capital of Belize.

cards.front: Quito is the capital of which country?
cards.explain: Quito is the capital of Ecuador.

cards.front: Guatemala City is the capital of which country?
cards.explain: Guatemala City is the capital of Guatemala.

cards.front: Tegucigalpa is the capital of which country?
cards.explain: Tegucigalpa is the capital of Honduras.

cards.front: Kingston is the capital of which country?
cards.explain: Kingston is the capital of Jamaica.

cards.front: Asunción is the capital of which country?
cards.explain: Asunción is the capital of Paraguay.

cards.front: Paramaribo is the capital of which country?
cards.explain: Paramaribo is the capital of Suriname.

cards.front: Port-of-Spain is the capital of which country?
cards.explain: Port-of-Spain is the capital of Trinidad and Tobago.

cards.front: Kingstown is the capital of which country?
cards.explain: Kingstown is the capital of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines.

cards.front: Caracas is the capital of which country?
cards.explain: Caracas is the capital of Venezuela (Bolivarian Republic of).
